args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18% after the latest deploy. Mitigated by rolling back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status is being verified; v2.3.1 should be investigated for the regression before redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (unhealthy) in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Actions taken**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions.
2. **Verified health**: post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the regression and the rollback mitigation; the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed, since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. The incident notes that v2.3.1 should be investigated for the regression before any redeploy attempt.
